transkript.t: Top five plugins to install in Clawed.
The first one is Superpowers.
It turns Clawed from a single agent
into an entire dev team.
It brainstorms with you, plans to build, writes the tests,
and reviews its own code before your client ever sees it.
The second one is Caveman.
It makes Clawed talk like an actual caveman.
It strips out the filler so you get the exact same code
with way fewer tokens and your plan lasts way longer.
Third is Clawed Code Setup.
It's an official Anthropic plugin that scans your project
and recommends the best hooks, scripts, sub-agents,
and MCP servers for it.
The fourth one is Project Artifacts.
Also from Anthropic, it turns your project
into a live status page.
You can send your clients what's done, what's next,
and what's at risk.
And finally, Clawed Security.
It's Anthropic's own security scan.
A team of agent hunts through your code,
double checks every finding, and hands you the fixes
before you ship it to a client.
Comment AI and I'll send you all five links.
